base_model.original: F4R1 trained source-preserved P69 DiagonalContinuousSSM, 256-float state

design.observed_effect: P80 seven bounded effect features and 9 zero targets
design.fast_state: 16x16 float32 factual residual matrix W, zero at each world start, 256-float persistent alongside frozen 256-float SSM =512
design.prediction: original SSM readout + W@current_action BEFORE y[t]
design.write: after y[t] observed, target residual = y[t]-SSM_readout, delta = target-(W@current_action), W += sigmoid(theta[0]+theta[1]*log(mean(delta^2)+1e-6)+theta[2]*log(mean((W@a)^2)+1e-6))*outer(delta,action)

frozen_fit.checkpoint: smallest FITdev four-physical-channel prequential MSE at 40,80,120,160,200,240; tie earlier step
